text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That math quiz absolutely ruined me! Aghhh, I can't believe myself!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I need to put more spirit into my
studying! But I
can't let it eat into my
training time either...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what if I just shouted out math
formulas
during training?! Sine! Cosine!
Tangent! Like that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, that wouldn't help if I don't even
know what
sine and cosine mean in the
first place...
